posts.title: Our brains are not wired, they are weighted
posts.description: "I am wired that way," we used to say. But with LLMs, we now have a better way of modeling our brains. We can now say "I am weighted that way.". Our brains are not wired. They are weighted. It is not the connections of neurons but the relative weights and strength of those neurons. This new way of thinking about how we think can be truly enlightening.
